text.jp:
ユ・ファスかあさまは、バロール神殿に
居た頃は仮面で素顔を隠していたらしいの。
text.official_en:
I understand that my mother, Yu Phas, hid her face
behind a mask while living in the temple of Balor.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それは、素顔でいるとよくないことが起こる
っていう、神祖さまの予言の関係らしいのだけど……
text.official_en:
There was a prophecy from the progenitor god that
bad luck would follow if her face went uncovered.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
でも、とうさまが嘆きの島を訪れたときに、
たまたま、かあさまの素顔を見てしまって、
text.official_en:
But, when my father inadvertently saw her face
during his visit to the Isle of Sorrows...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それでとうさまはかあさまに一目惚れしちゃって、
頼み込んで島から連れ出してしまったらしいの。
text.official_en:
Well, he fell in love with her and implored her to
leave the island with him.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そのときのとうさまの熱烈さにかあさまも
根負けしちゃったって言っていたけど……
text.official_en:
The story goes that she resisted my father's advances
at first.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
実際のところ、まんざらでもなかったみたい。
わたくしから見ても、お似合いの夫婦だったもの。
text.official_en:
In truth, she was never altogether displeased with
the idea. They were a wonderful couple.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でも……かあさまはいつも、心なしか
少し悲しそうにしていた気がするわ。
text.official_en:
Still, she did always seem to be a little melancholy.
It's hard to explain.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
わたくしには、当時、どうしてかあさまが
そんな顔をなさるのかわからなかったけれど……
text.official_en:
At the time, I didn't understand how she could
feel that way.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
前回のゼンゼルの事件のあとで思ったんだけど、
もしかしたらソレルさまは……
text.official_en:
I was thinking about the Zenzele situation. And now
I have a slight suspicion about Lord Solel.
text.real_en:
I was thinking about the Zenzele situation. And now
I have a slight suspicion about Sorell-sama.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アウロラさまの身を守るために、
あの鉄格子を設置させたんじゃないかしら。
text.official_en:
Is it possible he had that barrier installed to ensure
your mom's safety?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
わからないけど……もしかしたら犯人の
侵入を防ぐ目的があったのかもしれないし、
text.official_en:
I wonder if maybe he was trying to keep people out,
rather than keep her in.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
失踪事件が起こったときにあの内側にいたら
アウロラさまの身の潔白を証明出来るじゃない？
text.official_en:
That barrier would also serve as proof that she was
locked inside when more people vanished, right?

text.jp: <NCA>考え過ぎでは？
text.official_en: <NCA>Say she's overthinking it.

text.jp: <NCB>そうかもしれない
text.official_en: <NCB>Agree it's possible.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
<ACA>だって、女の子一人閉じ込めるのに、
あんな鉄格子、本当に必要だと思う？
text.official_en:
<ACA>At the very least, you have to admit there's no need
for a barrier so extreme—to lock away one woman.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もし……もし本当に
ソレルさまの本心がそうだったとしたら……
text.official_en: If protecting her was Lord Solel's true intention...
text.real_en: If protecting her was Sorell-sama's true intention...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あたし、あの人のこと少しだけ
見直してあげられるかもしれないわ。
text.official_en: I suppose I could revise my opinion of him. A little.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
とうとうこの時が来ちゃったね……
正直いうと、来てほしくなかったけど。
text.official_en:
Well. It's finally time, huh? To be honest, it got here
a little quicker than I'd hoped.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
次がいよいよ、あの恐ろしい
女王様との試合だなんて……
text.official_en: We have to fight the scary queen.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でも、大丈夫。ぼくは逃げないよ。
がんばって戦うから、ちゃんと見ていてね。
text.official_en:
I'm scared, but I'm going to fight the best I can.
You just watch me!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……うん、そうすればティアラもぼくのこと、
少しは見直してくれるよね、きっと。
text.official_en: This is my chance to prove myself to Tialla.
text.real_en: This is my chance to prove myself to Tiara.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
大剣闘祭の本戦で次に当たる人が誰かって
考えてると、どんどん気が重くなるよ。
text.official_en:
I can't stop worrying about who we'll face next in the
Heroic Games.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そのせいかなあ。いつもはごはんのお皿、
４杯くらいお代わりしてるけど……
text.official_en:
Maybe that's why I used to be able to eat four bowls
of rice...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
最近は３杯も食べたらそれだけで
胸がいっぱいになっちゃうんだ。
text.official_en: but these days, I'm full after barely three.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
このままだと痩せちゃいそうだなあ。
……そんなに悪いことでもないのかな？
text.official_en: If this keeps up, I might waste away...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
絵の中にいたときのことを思い出すと、
今でも背筋が寒くなることがあるの。
text.official_en:
I still get chills when I think about being inside
that painting.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ゼンゼルはわたしたちのことを
自分の家族って言っていたけれど……
text.official_en: Zenzele called all of us his family.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そんなものじゃないわ。
あんなの、家族への扱いなんかじゃない。
text.official_en: But that's no way to treat family.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まるで自分が人形になって、ゼンゼルの
棚に並べられ眺められているような……
text.official_en:
I felt more like a doll, sitting on Zenzele's shelf. I was
just there to be looked at.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
でも、こうして無事にこちら側に
帰ってこられて、本当にほっとしているの。
text.official_en: I'm so glad I made it back to this side of the canvas.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
つくづく、何もない平凡な暮らしが
一番の幸せなんだって実感できるわ。
text.official_en:
I have to say, a regular old life, with nothing much
going on? Might be the happiest you can be.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
御子様、わたし、
この御恩は一生忘れません！
text.official_en:
Cai, I'll never forget what you did for me...what I
owe you, for the rest of my life!
text.real_en:
Kai, I'll never forget what you did for me...what I
owe you, for the rest of my life!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ガブリエルから聞いたぜ。次はいよいよ
サラミス王国の女王と試合するんだってな。
text.official_en:
Gabriel says your next match is against the queen
of Saramis?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
俺も噂は聞いたことはあるが、
あの女はかなりやる筈だぞ。
text.official_en:
I've heard the rumors, and I don't imagine that lady
does things by halves.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
確か……サラミスのほうじゃ「鉄の女」って
異名で呼ばれてたはずだ。
text.official_en:
You know they call her the "Iron Bastion" back
in Saramis.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
おまけに周囲を固める側近共も
実戦で鍛え上げられた強者揃いときてる。
text.official_en:
And her entire crew is a bunch of legitimately
tough guys who've fought on real battlefields.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なにしろあの国は、隣のモーザと
しょっちゅう戦争してるからな。
text.official_en:
Saramis is always getting involved in one war or
another with their neighbors, the Mosa.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
とりあえず大きな怪我はしねえように、
十分気をつけてかかるんだぞ。
text.official_en:
Be careful out there, OK? Don't want to get hurt
before your match even starts.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ほう。このごろお前、
顔つきが変わってきたんじゃねえか？
text.official_en: You seem...different, lately.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そうだな……なんつーか、
男の顔になってきたって感じがするぜ。
text.official_en:
I don't know quite how to put it except that you're
starting to look more like a man than a kid.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だがな、あんまり妙なことに
首を突っ込まないようにしろよ。
text.official_en: Don't let it go to your head, alright?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
覚えとけ。人間、いい気になってる
時ってのが一番危ないんだからな。
text.official_en:
Easiest way to lose a fight is to be overly sure that
you're going to win it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私とカストールは、性格などは真逆ですが
昔から不思議と気は合いましてな……
text.official_en:
Castor and I are opposites in many ways, but we've
still been friends since the earliest times.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
カストールと私が知り合ったのは、
彼がバルカンの候補生になった頃……
text.official_en:
I got to know him when he was still a candidate for
the vulkans.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私が、教官として彼の指導を
担当したのがきっかけでした。
text.official_en: Believe it or not, I was his instructor.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
若い頃のカストールは、腕は立つものの、
それはもう素行に問題がありすぎるほどで、
text.official_en:
He was incredibly skilled at a young age, but his
behavior was problematic in the extreme.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
彼の与えられた“暴風”の二つ名は、
実はそれがもとになっておるのです。
text.official_en:
That's how he came by the name Windstorm.
It wasn't given to him as a compliment.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そして、私とエスティは、先輩として
ずいぶん尻拭いをさせられたものです。
text.official_en:
Estie and I, both his seniors, had to clean up an
awful lot of his messes.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そのこともあって、カストールは昔も今も
エスティには頭が上がらぬ様子ですが……
text.official_en:
Because of that history, Castor has never been able
to stand as an equal with Estie.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ん？　エスティですか？
御子様もよくご存知の相手だと思いますが。
text.official_en: Hmm? Estie? You know her very well, Cai.
text.real_en: Hmm? Estie? You know her very well, Kai.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
彼女はピーテルの母親でありますから、
ええ、そのエスティにございますよ。
text.official_en: Peter's mother. Yes, that Estie.
